I stayed here for 2 days, the overall experience at Hotel Ambika Palace was extremely disappointing and far below expectations. From the moment I entered the room, I realized this place seriously lacks basic cleanliness and maintenance. The room looked as if it had not been cleaned properly for days. Dust was visible on furniture, and the floor was so dirty that walking barefoot felt unhygienic. The corners of the room had cobwebs, and even the walls seemed stained and unwashed. It was not at all what one would expect after paying for a decent stay.The bathroom conditions were worse. The water supplied was hard and left stains on tiles and taps, making it unpleasant for both showering and washing. The shower fittings were either broken or rusted, and the bad smell from the drain made it unbearable to use. One would expect at least basic maintenance in a hotel claiming to be a “palace,” but sadly, the hygiene standards here were completely unacceptable.The bed linens and pillow covers looked used and were not changed before my arrival. There was a damp, musty odor in the entire room which made it difficult to breathe comfortably. Air circulation was very poor, and the air conditioner made constant noise without cooling properly. I found it impossible to sleep peacefully due to noise from other rooms and corridors. The walls were so thin that every conversation and footstep could be heard clearly, especially late at night when guests returned or staff moved around.Even the surroundings of the hotel were noisy and chaotic. Instead of feeling relaxed, I felt continuously disturbed. The housekeeping staff seemed careless, and front desk service was indifferent to complaints. When I mentioned these problems, there was a casual response instead of any real attempt to make things better.Hotel Ambika Palace needs serious renovation, professional cleaning, and staff training before claiming to provide any form of comfort to its guests. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone who values cleanliness, comfort, or peaceful rest.

Never stay at this hotel! The rooms are filthy, with broken bathroom commodes, leaking taps, and cockroaches roaming near the beds. Rs 1000/day is enough for this hotel, but they charging more than Rs 3000 per night.The service is third-class, and the staff are dishonest—they sell ₹20 water bottles for ₹45 and provide fake F&B bills to hide the overcharge. On top of that, the food quality is terrible. Totally not worth your money!
